properties.name: Broadway–55th St. & Woodland Ave. (per detail panel)
properties.note: The map's quick index lists route 9 as 'Broadway-64th St.', but its own detailed routing panel describes this number as ending at '55th St. & Woodland Ave.' instead (matching what the index calls route 10) -- the map's two panels disagree with each other, not just with this dashboard's reading of them.
